description: This file defines the ConvertHex class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods for converting hexadecimal numbers to binary, decimal, and octal representations, including handling of errors and arrays of inputs.

classes.name: ConvertHex
classes.description: Provides static methods to convert hexadecimal values to binary, decimal, and octal formats within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: toBinary
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal value to its binary representation, supporting array inputs and handling negative values using two's complement notation.

methods.name: toDecimal
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal value to its decimal equivalent, supporting array inputs and handling two's complement negative numbers.

methods.name: toOctal
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal value to its octal representation, supporting array inputs and error conditions.

methods.name: validateHex
methods.description: Validates that a hexadecimal string contains only valid hexadecimal characters, throws an error if not.
